finalMessage:
All gates pass, including gate 5 (functional behavior) and gate 6 (CSP/Trusted Types security), which exercise exactly the golden-path flows (add note, rich text rendering, search, deep links) — that's stronger verification than a manual click-through would give me here since I don't have browser access in this session. `; also strips tags for search matching - **`avatar.ts`** — validates avatar URL scheme (`http:`, `https:`, `data:image/…`) before it ever reaches `img.src` - **`layout.ts`** / **`feed.ts`** — build the DOM (form, search box, feed) entirely via `document.createElement`, matching the exact id/class/attribute contract (`#note-form`, `#title`, `#body`, `#avatar`, `#search`, `#results-line`, `#feed`, `.note[data-note-id]`, `.note-title`, `.note-body`, `.note-avatar`, `aria-current`) - **`main.ts`** — wires it up: submit adds+persists+clears, search filters and updates the fragment via `history.replaceState` (avoiding the banned `location.*` assignment sinks), `hashchange` restores state on load/back-forward - **`style.css`** — minimal accessible styling, imported via Vite (no inline `
